title: Paul McCartney live: Wiener Stadthalle, Vienna | 2018
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Wiener Stadthalle in Vienna, Austria, on 6 December 2018.

It was the 15th show of the Freshen Up Tour, which lasted for 39 dates between September 2018 and July 2019, and the second of two consecutive nights in Vienna.

I can’t believe it’s been five years since our last concert in Austria. We are really excited to be returning for what should be an extra special night. We’ve got so many great memories of Austria and we know we’ll make some more this year. The audience have always been so welcoming and up for rocking out with us. Get ready for another big night of partying.
Paul McCartney
paulmccartney.com

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

Wings had performed at the Wiener Stadthalle on 19 September 1976. McCartney returned there during the New World Tour on 5 and 6 September 1993, and for the Back In The World Tour on 14 May 2003.
